lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 15-20 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in four semi-parallel horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, with the highest density observed in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with blob centroids to create a faint rectangular grid pattern, partially obscured by light caustics in the anterior section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular, prominent horizontal linear feature displaying a high-contrast luminance gradient (light superior, dark inferior) extending from the upper margin of the gill slits toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced optical caustic patterns from surface light refraction create a secondary, transient high-intensity mesh overlay across the anterior-lateral flank.
